notes: The first optional-lab launch exposed automatic art-scene and injury-scene reset ordering. Injury UI now waits for the art scene initialization; subsequent startup checks passed.
A test fixture initially positioned a target without resetting its smoothed rig origin; initializing that existing rig correctly allowed a real native arm contact. No collider was expanded.

The full native suites ran after the completed common hooks. A final lab-only corpse guard preserves native corpse damage; final targeted physical integration reran from a rebuilt export after that guard and stronger particle-cap/original-14-shot assertions. Existing off modes do not import that policy module.

The frozen fixtures explicitly finish native removal callbacks before particle-cap stress, preventing the separate native per-type effect budget from masking the laboratory cap. Native constructors, onThink, _remove and registry methods are used; effect counters are never reset or mocked.
Controlled native target stepping demonstrates state transitions and finite rigs; it does not establish subjective combat feel or medical realism.
Older milestone evidence was written under a temporary working directory and is unchanged in the repository.
